Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: premium real estate homepage service card illustration, a standalone transparent raster asset.
Primary request: a sophisticated editorial still life representing the sale of an apartment: a beautifully organized real-estate sale dossier rather than a generic real-estate icon.
Subject: an open ivory paper portfolio containing a printed apartment floor plan with exquisite fine graphite technical lines, windows, walls and door swings but no labels; a neatly offset warm offwhite sale estimate sheet with only subtle pale blue and graphite geometric chart marks and ruled lines, no letters or numbers; one elegant brushed silver pen laid diagonally along the portfolio; a small tasteful tactile model fragment of a contemporary apartment-building facade in ivory plaster and pale oak, including three glass windows; one understated translucent cool blue oversized paper clip holding the papers. Restrained realistic professional objects, tightly curated as one single still-life group, not scattered clutter. Foreground paper corners visibly separate, beautiful material depth.
Composition/framing: a composed top-down LOW OBLIQUE editorial view at around 40 degrees above the papers, with the folder diagonal across the image from lower left to upper right and the small facade fragment at the back right. The papers are the main subject and the architectural model is secondary. Complete objects fully visible, no clipping, compact silhouette with roughly 8% clear transparent margin around all edges. Landscape 4:3 composition. Intended to display at about 340 by 260 CSS pixels in the lower-right area of a light homepage service panel.
Style/medium: refined photorealistic product still life with convincing tactile paper grain, precise technical drawing, brushed metal highlights, mineral plaster, fine oak grain and believable slightly blue glass. Premium editorial realism, no simplistic toy forms or glossy plastic.
Lighting/mood: diffuse upper-left studio daylight, soft realistic contact shadows beneath paper layers and a faint semi-transparent ambient shadow below the whole group. Calm understated quality.
Color palette: warm offwhite paper, ivory plaster, pale oak, graphite lines and restrained cool muted blue transparent clip accent.
Scene/backdrop: TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background outside the object group, absolutely no opaque backdrop, desktop or studio sweep; preserve very subtle semitransparent contact shadows so the group sits naturally on a pale sage offwhite webpage (#e9ede8).
Constraints: no humans, no keys, no house keychains, no typography, no words, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. No readable or fake text on papers, only realistic unlabeled floor-plan technical lines and abstract ruled estimate sheet. No cartoon style, no opaque background.
